map.Devine公式于1974年由Dr. Bernard Devine提出，最初只是: The Devine formula was proposed in 1974 by Dr. Bernard Devine, originally an empirical formula to quickly estimate theophylline dose. Because it is simple, it gradually became the clinical gold standard for IBW. But note IBW is not 'healthy weight'; it is only a reference for drug dosing.

map.IBW 和 BMI 理想体重有什么区别？: What is the difference between IBW and BMI ideal weight?
map.IBW（如 Devine）是临床剂量经验公式，与身高线性相关；BMI 理想体重是: IBW (e.g. Devine) is a clinical dosing empirical formula, linear with height; BMI ideal weight is a range from 'healthy BMI x height²' (e.g. 53.5-69.1 kg). The former is for dosing, the latter for weight management; values are close but not identical.
map.肌肉型人 IBW 偏低，按 IBW 给药会不会太少？: For muscular people IBW is low; will dosing by IBW be too little?
map.对肌肉量明显超常者，单纯 IBW 会低估，临床常用「校正体重 = IBW + 0: For clearly above-normal muscle mass, IBW alone underestimates; clinically a 'adjusted weight = IBW + 0.4 x (actual − IBW)' compromise is used. This tool gives the IBW baseline; the specific dosing plan must be adjusted by the doctor by body composition.
